description: Sri  Lanka Customs - Notify the Rates of Exchange effective from 13.08.2018 to 19.08.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette as it involves statutory instruments and compliance requirements for customs procedures.
